description:
Local Windows dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build / X Subscription, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenCode Go, and DeepSeek usage.

AI Usage Dashboard is a local-first Windows desktop dashboard and
screensaver for viewing Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, Antigravity,
and OpenCode Go usage windows alongside a DeepSeek API balance. Display
Settings provide a write-only DeepSeek API key field, optional X (Grok and
Cursor), Antigravity, and OpenCode Go panels that stay off by default, and
an optional Low Power Mode that disables animation and reduces renderer
update work. Credentials and provider requests stay in the native Rust
backend; the renderer receives sanitized usage summaries only. Accounts on
the X Subscription show Grok and Cursor as one shared weekly pool split by
product. The project has no developer-operated server, analytics, or
telemetry.
